limitations: 208/208 is reviewed source-contract accounting, not binary/CFG matching, full shared-engine coverage or measured feature fidelity.
Portable callbacks cover release, exact refusal precedence, conditional scroll continuation and availability. Shared mutation/selector/renderer/save bodies are not counted again.

Native host scenarios verify assets, child routing, isolated save failure/retry/restart/Reset and population preservation. Original Compare/Cancel/reopen retains Longley without a prompt; subsequent ordinary discard restores Parish while retaining Longley; ordinary accept/reopen retains Parish with Wennington starting; View/Cancel/reopen independently retains Wennington with Salley starting and no prompt. These are session checks, not original memory-card persistence.

Nine-frame scroll wait/state is implemented; original intermediate glyph animation, transition cadence and audio waveform comparison remain unverified. Full-pool one-past cursor is safely represented without emulating out-of-bounds reads.
